articles.title: BREAKING: Himalayan Flood Disaster Leaves Hundreds Dead and Nearly 1,000 Missing
articles.description: A catastrophic flash flood and landslide disaster in the Himalayan region has killed at least 359 people and left nearly 1,000 missing, according to the latest Reuters reporting. Rescue teams are searching for survivors while authorities warn of additional flooding risks from debris-dammed lakes.

articles.title: Hormuz Shipping Talks Continue
articles.description: Iran and Oman are discussing arrangements that could allow more shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. No final reopening agreement has been reached and vessel traffic remains far below normal levels.
articles.imageQuery: Strait of Hormuz Iran Oman tanker shipping

articles.title: Russia's NORSI Refinery Hit by Drone Attack
articles.description: Russia's NORSI refinery has halted crude processing following a Ukrainian drone attack, according to industry sources cited by Reuters. The disruption could place additional pressure on regional fuel supplies.

articles.title: US Reviews Military Presence in Europe
articles.description: The Pentagon is conducting a major review of US military deployments across Europe. Several options are reportedly being prepared, while NATO allies watch closely for any changes to the American military presence.

articles.title: US Markets Watch Oil and Federal Reserve Policy
articles.description: US investors are closely monitoring oil prices, geopolitical developments and Federal Reserve policy as energy-market uncertainty continues to influence inflation expectations and financial markets.
articles.imageQuery: Wall Street stock market traders United States

articles.title: European Energy Markets Watch Hormuz
articles.description: European governments and energy companies continue monitoring the Strait of Hormuz because prolonged disruption could affect fuel prices, gas supplies and inflation across the region.
articles.imageQuery: European energy market gas oil terminal

articles.title: NATO Allies Watch US Troop Review
articles.description: European NATO allies are closely watching Washington's review of US military commitments in Europe as governments assess the possible implications for regional security.

articles.title: BREAKING: Nigeria Football Federation Leadership Resigns
articles.description: Nigeria Football Federation President Ibrahim Musa Gusau, General Secretary Mohammed Sanusi and members of the executive committee have resigned. The leadership change follows intense criticism after Nigeria failed to qualify for the 2026 men's World Cup and the Super Falcons failed to qualify for the 2027 Women's World Cup.

articles.title: Nigeria's Kidnapping Crisis Remains a Major Security Concern
articles.description: Nigeria continues to face a serious kidnapping crisis. A study cited by Reuters estimates that gunmen collected almost $5.8 million in ransom payments from civilian abductions between July 2025 and June 2026.

articles.title: Thousands of Abductions Recorded in Nigeria
articles.description: Research cited by Reuters recorded thousands of abductions and more than 1,100 killings over the past year, highlighting the growing security and economic consequences of kidnapping in Nigeria.

articles.title: Dangote Refinery Strengthens Nigeria's Fuel Export Position
articles.description: Nigeria's petroleum-product exports by sea have increased sharply since 2023, with the Dangote refinery contributing significantly to the country's growing role as a regional fuel supplier.

articles.title: MTN Considers Banking Expansion in Africa
articles.description: MTN Group is considering banking licences in selected African markets as the telecommunications company expands its financial-services operations.

articles.title: Oil Prices Continue Lower
articles.description: Oil prices have fallen as markets react to the possibility of improved shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude remains around the high-$80s per barrel while uncertainty continues.

articles.title: Global Markets Remain Sensitive to Geopolitical Risk
articles.description: Investors continue watching oil prices, bond yields, inflation expectations and geopolitical developments as uncertainty surrounding energy supplies affects global markets.

articles.title: Nigeria Kidnapping Crisis Has Major Economic Impact
articles.description: Research into ransom payments highlights the financial incentives behind kidnapping and the growing economic challenge facing Nigerian security agencies, businesses and affected communities.

articles.title: Nvidia Strengthens Global AI Investment Story
articles.description: Nvidia's latest results and outlook have strengthened investor confidence in artificial intelligence spending. Markets continue assessing whether enormous investments in AI infrastructure can generate sustainable long-term returns.

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence Remains a Major Investment Story
articles.description: Technology companies continue investing heavily in AI chips, computing infrastructure and data centres as investors search for evidence that the current AI boom can translate into sustainable growth.

morningSummary.title: MORNING SUMMARY
morningSummary.description: Today's global picture is dominated by the catastrophic Himalayan floods, Nigeria's football leadership shake-up and continuing security concerns. Internationally, the Strait of Hormuz remains central to energy markets, while the disruption at Russia's NORSI refinery adds another pressure point to fuel supplies. The United States is reviewing its military presence in Europe, while Nvidia and the wider artificial-intelligence sector remain major investment stories.

bigQuestion: When a crisis affects thousands of people, what matters most — immediate rescue, long-term prevention, or holding those responsible accountable?
